{{Quote|After the war, Zeb took Kallus along the secret hyperspace path to the planet Lira San. It was then that Kallus realized he hadn't destroyed the Lasat people, and that they were thriving on this new world. A world where he was welcomed as one of them.|[[Sabine Wren]]|<ref name="Family&Farewell">{{Rebels|Family Reunion – and Farewell}}</ref>}}
'''Lira San''' was a remote [[planet]] located in the [[Lira San system]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Wild Space]] region. Hidden behind<ref name="Legends of the Lasat" /> a treacherous [[nebula]] formed from<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> an imploded [[star]] [[Star cluster|cluster]], it was the original [[homeworld]] of the [[Lasat]] [[species]]. Though many Lasat dwelled on [[Lasan]], millions of Lasat remained on Lira San, but their existence was forgotten by the people of Lasan, who knew of Lira San only through an ancient [[Prophecy of the Three|prophecy]]. This prophecy led three Lasat—[[Garazeb Orrelios]], [[Chava]], and [[Gron]], with the help of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]—to find Lira San after the people of Lasan were [[Siege of Lasan|nearly exterminated]] by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Legends of the Lasat" />

Following the [[Galactic Civil War]], Zeb took former [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus]] to Lira San to show Kallus that he did not extinguish the entire Lasat race, and Kallus was welcomed to join their society.<ref name="Family&Farewell" />
